en_title: Naruto Movie Closes in on Casting Hiroyuki Sanada as Live-Action Hiruzen Sarutobi
cn_title: 真人版《Naruto》电影接近敲定真田广之饰演Hiruzen Sarutobi
opus_summary: 据Deadline报道，真田广之正就出演《火影忍者》真人电影中的猿飞日斩进行最终谈判。Charles Melton仍在洽谈加盟，两人的角色均未获正式确认。影片预计于2027年春季开拍，目前尚无上映日期；Lionsgate已启动第七班主演的全球选角。

paragraphs.en: Hiroyuki Sanada has reportedly entered final negotiations to play Hiruzen Sarutobi in Destin Daniel Cretton's live-action Naruto movie .
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，真田广之已进入最终洽谈阶段，有望在德斯汀·克里顿执导的真人版《Naruto》电影中饰演Hiruzen Sarutobi。

paragraphs.en: The Mortal Kombat and Shogun actor's potential role in the anime-to-film adaptation was first reported by Deadline . Should talks with Cretton and Lionsgate check those last few boxes, he will appear as the Hidden Leaf Village's Hokage leader.
paragraphs.cn: 这位曾出演《真人快打》和《幕府将军》的演员可能参演这部动画改编电影的消息，最早由Deadline报道。如果与克里顿和Lionsgate的洽谈解决了最后几个问题，他将出演Hidden Leaf Village的领袖Hokage。

paragraphs.en: How Sanada may help the iconic Hokage lead to the big screen remains to be seen. Meanwhile, the site's report stated that Charles Melton (Warfare, Beef Season 2), who was said to be in final negotiations to play Kakashi back in August, is still in talks to join Naruto.
paragraphs.cn: 真田广之可能如何帮助这位标志性的Hokage领袖登上大银幕，还有待观察。与此同时，该网站的报道称，查尔斯·梅尔顿（《Warfare》《怒呛人生》第二季）仍在洽谈加盟《Naruto》；今年8月曾有消息称，他正就饰演Kakashi进行最终洽谈。

paragraphs.en: The Spider-Man: Brand New Day director's shot at bringing one of the most beloved manga and anime properties of all time into the live-action realm is expected to begin filming sometime in spring 2027 . With production right around the corner, though, Sony and Lionsgate have shared little about which actors have been picked to play some of the franchise's most important roles.
paragraphs.cn: 这位《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》导演尝试将有史以来最受喜爱的漫画和动画作品之一搬上真人荧幕，影片预计于2027年春季的某个时候开拍。不过，尽管制作即将开始，索尼和Lionsgate对于哪些演员被选中饰演该系列中一些最重要的角色，透露的信息仍然很少。

paragraphs.en: The only names we've heard so far are Melton and Sanada, and even their parts in the story haven't been outright confirmed just yet. Depending on what story Cretton and company hope to tell, there is still plenty of room for additional casting updates. Names like Sasuke, Sakura, and, of course, Naruto still have no names publicly attached, though that doesn't necessarily mean that stars haven't been picked behind the scenes.
paragraphs.cn: 到目前为止，我们听到的名字只有梅尔顿和真田广之，而就连他们在故事中的角色也尚未得到明确确认。取决于克里顿及其团队希望讲述什么样的故事，后续仍有很大的空间公布更多选角消息。Sasuke、Sakura以及当然还有Naruto等角色，仍未公开与任何演员的名字联系在一起，但这并不一定意味着幕后尚未选定演员。

paragraphs.en: Lionsgate confirmed it had initiated a global casting search for actors to play the leads in the live-action Naruto picture. Specifically, it said it was on the lookout for stars for Team 7, suggesting the actors picked to appear as Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura could be unknown names in the movie space.
paragraphs.cn: Lionsgate确认，公司已启动全球选角，为真人版《Naruto》电影寻找主演。具体来说，公司表示正在为Team 7寻找演员，这表明被选中饰演Naruto、Sasuke和Sakura的演员可能是电影界的无名新人。

paragraphs.en: "[Naruto creator Masashi Kishimoto-sensei's] stories have inspired generations of fans around the world, and it’s an honor to bring his world and characters to the big screen in live action for the very first time," Cretton said at the time of the global casting search reveal. "I'm thrilled to kick off this worldwide casting search for our Team 7 and to bring the incredible universe of Naruto to life!"
paragraphs.cn: 克里顿在全球选角消息公布时表示：「《Naruto》创作者Masashi Kishimoto老师的故事激励了世界各地一代又一代的粉丝，我很荣幸能首次以真人形式将他的世界和角色搬上大银幕。我很高兴能为我们的Team 7启动这次全球选角，并让《Naruto》令人惊叹的宇宙变得鲜活起来！」

paragraphs.en: The live-action Naruto movie currently has no release date. For more, you can check out Kishimoto's new manga tease . You can also catch up on how to watch all of Naruto in order .
paragraphs.cn: 真人版《Naruto》电影目前尚无上映日期。想了解更多，你可以看看Kishimoto对新漫画的预告。你也可以了解如何按顺序观看《Naruto》的全部内容。
